articles.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Gildan Activewear for investors who purchased securities between February 19, 2025 and June 15, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Gildan engaged in channel stuffing and lacked adequate internal controls to artificially inflate revenues by approximately $500 million. Following a short-seller report on June 16, 2026, Gildan's stock fell 18.7%. The deadline to join the class action is December 14, 2026.
